versions.changelog:
trade-executor v0.1.0

- Initial release of trade-executor for executing cryptocurrency trades on Binance and OKX.
- Implements complete risk controls, including whitelist pairs, per-trade and daily limits, stop-loss enforcement, and session-aware checks.
- Requires explicit user confirmation for every order before execution.
- Supports both user-initiated and pre-authorized market-monitor signals (with confidence ≥ 0.85).
- Orders are only executed when all safety checks pass; detailed rejection reasons provided otherwise.
- All trades are logged for audit with structured records; no persistent writes by Vega itself.
